# Threads Code Saver (threads-embedded-code)
> Lightweight pure front-end browser extension built on Google Chrome Extensions Manifest V3 for automatically capturing, sanitizing, managing, previewing, and exporting Threads post embed codes together with their structured metadata.

## Core Metadata
- Project Name: Threads Code Saver
- Current Version: 2.2.0
- Specification: Google Chrome Extensions Manifest V3
- Tech Stack: Pure Native JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3 Custom Properties (Zero external dependencies, zero compilation/build step)
- Data Persistence: Browser local storage (chrome.storage.local, 10MB quota, privacy-first). Saved data never leaves the browser; network access is limited to Threads domains (live preview and background updates) plus the Google Fonts stylesheets imported by popup.css and dashboard.css.
- Accessibility: In-page modals only (no native confirm/alert/prompt), focus trapping, live regions, 4.5:1 contrast, undersized hit targets enlarged to at least 24x24px, 12px minimum font size, prefers-reduced-motion support
- License: MIT ([LICENSE](./LICENSE))
- Source Repository: https://github.com/Scorpio-meow/threads-embedded-code
- Companion Showcase Repository: https://github.com/Scorpio-meow/Threads-Featured-Posts (Consumes exported featured post data as its primary dataset)

## Core Files
- manifest.json: Extension configuration manifest declaring Manifest V3 specs, permissions (storage, tabs, scripting), host matches for threads.com and threads.net, `all_frames: true` content script injection, and strict CSP headers.
- content.js: Primary Content Script. On Threads pages it observes DOM mutations, intercepts the official embed dialog, scores embed candidates, extracts top-level text containers, filters image-only descriptions, and strips UI/timestamp noise. Inside `/embed` iframes it switches to `handleEmbedFrameResize()` and reports the measured `.Embed` height to the parent window.
- styles.css: Injected notification styles for Threads web pages, including live-region toast styling and prefers-reduced-motion fallbacks.
- popup.html: 480px width browser toolbar popup markup, including the confirm, import-source, import-paste, and import-mode modals.
- popup.css: Toolbar popup stylesheet featuring dark theme tokens, responsive card lists, and reduced-motion support.
- popup.js: Toolbar popup controller supporting debounced keyword search (180ms), 6 sorting rules, 6 filter categories, single-item maintenance, undoable deletion, in-page modals, file/paste import, and selection-aware export.
- dashboard.html: Full-page management dashboard markup including the Live Preview modal (with loading and error states), statistical clouds, batch action toolbar, and confirmation/import modals.
- dashboard.css: Dashboard stylesheet containing CSS Grid cards, preview modal layout, transition animations, and reduced-motion support.
- dashboard.js: Dashboard core controller managing the Live Preview modal, sequential asynchronous update queue (with pause/resume/cancel signals), Top 15 tag/author clouds, batch operations, undo snapshots, and in-page confirmation dialogs.
- favicon.png: 128x128 extension icon asset.
- README.md: Comprehensive Traditional Chinese technical documentation with Mermaid diagrams, schemas, and developer guide.
- llms.txt: Structured technical specifications for AI agents and LLM/RAG indexing pipelines.

## Data Models & Schema
All post records are stored as an array of SavedArticle objects within the `savedArticles` key in `chrome.storage.local`.

### SavedArticle Interface
```typescript
interface SavedArticle {
  /** Unique primary identifier (new saves: embed_[timestamp]_[random]; imports: imported_[timestamp]_[random], or the id carried by the source file) */
  id: string;

  /** Canonical Threads post URL, used as unique key for deduplication and updates */
  postLink: string;

  /** Official Threads native <blockquote> embed HTML code */
  embedCode: string;

  /** Publication timestamp in ISO 8601 standard format */
  timestamp: string;

  /** Formatted publication title string (e.g., "May 29, 2026, 10:00 AM") */
  timestampTitle: string;

  /** Local storage timestamp in ISO 8601 format */
  savedAt: string;

  /** Sanitized plaintext content preserving natural paragraph line breaks */
  content: string;

  /** Author username handle including @ prefix (e.g., "@username") */
  author: string;

  /** Array of extracted hashtags and keyword tags */
  tags: string[];

  /** Post operational status */
  status: 'active' | 'expired';

  /** Timestamp when the post was marked as expired (ISO 8601) */
  expiredAt?: string;

  /** Specific reason for expiration */
  expiredReason?: 'redirected' | 'post-not-found' | 'fallback-summary' | 'unknown';

  /** Timestamp of the last status check attempt (ISO 8601) */
  expiredCheckedAt?: string;

  /** Timestamp when publication timestamp was last updated (ISO 8601) */
  timestampUpdatedAt?: string;

  /** Source format indicator when imported */
  importedFrom?: 'full-data-file' | 'js-embed-file';
}
```

### Removed in 2.2.0
- The `authorUrl` field was removed. Nothing read it (UI, search, filters, statistics, and all three exports ignored it), and it can be derived from `author` or `postLink`. Newly saved and imported records no longer include it; records saved by older versions may still hold a stale value, which nothing reads.

### Removed in 2.1.0 (Breaking Change)
- The `codeBlocks: CodeBlock[]` and `codeCount: number` fields, the `CodeBlock` interface, and all related UI (code cards, code search, code copy buttons, and the code import field) were removed.
- The extraction logic had been unreachable since the embed-dialog capture flow replaced the legacy save flow, so newly saved records always contained an empty array.
- Importing an older backup no longer preserves these fields, and code text is no longer part of the search index. Search now matches `content`, `author`, `tags`, and `embedCode`, which is also what both search inputs now advertise.
- Follow-up cleanup: `refreshEmbedCode` and its private `buildThreadsEmbedCode` copy were deleted from popup.js because their button had already been removed from the markup, and the `lastUpdated` field they wrote was dropped from the schema. Exports and imports never carried it; only records saved by older versions may still hold a stale value, which nothing reads.

## Key Concepts & Algorithms

### 1. Top-Level Text Container Layout Extraction
- Targets primary content nodes: `span[class*="xo1l8bm"][dir="auto"]`, `span[class*="xi7mnp6"][dir="auto"]`, and `div[class*="x1iorvi4"][dir="auto"]`.
- Strictly ignores `time` tags, permalink tags (`a[href*="/post/"]`, `a[href*="/t/"]`), author header links (`a[href*="/@"]`), and Meta AI promotional text.
- Applies `isLikelyImageOnlyDescription` heuristic to filter out media captions.
- Deduplicates containers hierarchically and invokes `innerText.trim()`, preserving paragraph breaks and `<br>` elements without whitespace collapse.

### 2. Embed Dialog Weighted Scoring Algorithm
- Scans all readonly input fields within the embed modal and scores candidates:
  - Base string length score
  - Contains `data-text-post-permalink`: +1000 points
  - Contains `<blockquote`: +500 points
  - Contains `threads.com`: +100 points
- Selects the highest-scoring candidate to ensure 100% complete blockquote retrieval.

### 3. Tag Extraction & Technology Keyword Mapping
- `extractTags` merges three sources: official hashtag anchors (`a[href*="serp_type=tags"]`, `a[href*="tag_id="]`, reading the `q` query parameter first and falling back to link text), inline hashtags matched by `/#([a-zA-Z0-9_\u4e00-\u9fa5]+)/g`, and a 12-entry technology keyword map (JavaScript, Python, Java, C++, C#, HTML, CSS, SQL, TypeScript, React, Vue, Angular).
- All tags are normalized with `String.prototype.normalize('NFC')` and deduplicated through a `Set`.
- The injected `extractPostInfoFromPage` used by the background update queue runs the same logic, so every update also refreshes the tag list.

### 4. 41-Rule Noise & Timestamp Filtering Pipeline
- `cleanExtractedPostContent` normalizes whitespace, strips carousel counters (e.g., 1/5), translation buttons, and "view original" labels, then collapses redundant blank lines.
- `isLikelyThreadsFallbackDescription` evaluates every line against 41 regular expressions covering relative timestamps (e.g., "2d", "1h", "just now", "yesterday"), follower metrics, thread counts, view counts, and navigation items across Traditional Chinese and English UI locales. Matching lines are dropped entirely.

### 5. Live Preview Protocol & Dynamic Height Adaptation
- Dual-tab interface supporting Official Embed preview and Raw Source/Metadata inspection.
- Fixed preview width of 658px (official Threads standard). The multi-device width switcher was removed in 2.1.0.
- Height adaptation: because the official `/embed` page does not report its own height, `content.js` is injected into the preview iframe (`all_frames: true`) and measures the `.Embed` container via ResizeObserver/MutationObserver, media `load`/`loadeddata`/`error` events, and 8 staged re-measurements (50ms to 4000ms), posting `{ type: 'THREADS_EMBED_RESIZE', height }` to the parent window.
- The dashboard validates `event.origin` against `threads.net`, `threads.com`, and `instagram.com`, also accepts the official `MEASURE` payload shape, and applies heights between 100px and 5000px.
- Explicit load states: loading spinner, 10-second timeout state, and load-failure state, the latter two offering a retry button. Posts without a usable link show a non-retryable message pointing to the Raw Source tab.
- Keyboard navigation: ESC to close, Left Arrow / Right Arrow for previous/next post navigation.

### 6. Background Sequential Update Queue
- Queue scope: the selected posts when any checkbox is checked, otherwise the current filtered and sorted list.
- Executes updates sequentially inside a single reusable hidden tab (`chrome.tabs.update`) to eliminate rate limiting or high CPU usage. The tab is closed on extraction failure and in the `finally` block once the queue ends.
- No waiting limits: `waitForTabNavigation` resolves only on `status === 'complete'` or tab removal, and the injected extractor polls every 80ms until data is found or the post is classified as expired.
- Supports pause, resume, and cancellation signals; results are written back to `chrome.storage.local` after every single post, so partial progress is never lost.
- Automatically marks posts as expired on redirect, post-not-found (404/deleted), or platform fallback summary, and restores them to active once accessible again.

### 7. 6 Filter Dimensions & 6 Sorting Rules
- Filter Categories:
  - `all`: All stored posts
  - `author`: Filter by specific author handle
  - `tag`: Filter by specific hashtag/topic
  - `noContent`: Posts without a text body (image-only or empty descriptions)
  - `noTimestamp`: Posts lacking a timestamp or requiring synchronization
  - `expired`: Deleted, privatized, or redirected posts
- Sorting Rules:
  - `savedAt-desc` / `savedAt-asc`: Saved time Newest / Oldest
  - `timestamp-desc` / `timestamp-asc`: Publish time Newest / Oldest
  - `author-asc` / `author-desc`: Author handle A-Z / Z-A
- The legacy "code count" sorting option was removed in 2.1.0.

### 8. Accessibility & Recoverable Operations
- Native `confirm()`, `alert()`, and `prompt()` are never used. Every dialog is an in-page modal with `role="dialog"`, `aria-modal="true"`, labelled title/description, initial focus, Tab focus trapping, ESC dismissal, and focus restoration to the triggering control. This matters most in the MV3 popup, where a native dialog is dismissed together with the popup on blur and returns its default value.
- Destructive actions are recoverable: single delete, batch delete, and clear-all show an undo toast (8 seconds by default). Only one undo toast exists at a time, so an older snapshot can never roll back newer changes.
- Overwrite imports require a second confirmation modal; dismissing it or pressing ESC always cancels.
- Batch actions use the `disabled` attribute rather than `pointer-events: none`, so keyboard activation is blocked as well.
- Toast containers and injected Threads notifications are live regions (`role="status"` / `aria-live="polite"`, escalating to `role="alert"` / `assertive` for errors). Error messages also stay visible longer: 5 seconds for panel toasts and 6 seconds for injected Threads notifications, versus 2.5 seconds for regular messages.
- Tag and author cloud badges are `button` elements with `aria-pressed` reflecting the active filter.
- Search inputs use a 180ms debounce (`SEARCH_DEBOUNCE_MS`); clouds display the top 15 entries (`CLOUD_VISIBLE_LIMIT`) with an overflow note.
- Contrast is raised to 4.5:1, undersized hit targets are enlarged to at least 24x24px, font sizes are floored at 12px, and all three stylesheets honor `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.

## Export & Import Specifications

### Export Formats
All three exports are selection-aware: when posts are checked only those are exported, otherwise the current filtered list is exported.

1. Embed Only: `threads-embed-codes-YYYY-MM-DD.js`
   ```javascript
   const posts = [
       '<blockquote class="text-post-media" data-text-post-permalink="...">...</blockquote>'
   ];
   ```
2. Featured Data: `threads-featured-data-YYYY-MM-DD.js` (Formatted for Threads-Featured-Posts; author without @ prefix)
   ```javascript
   const posts = [
       {
           "embedCode": "...",
           "postLink": "https://www.threads.com/@user/post/...",
           "author": "user",
           "content": "...",
           "tags": ["JavaScript"]
       }
   ];
   ```
3. Full Backup Data: `threads-full-data-YYYY-MM-DD.js` (Content, timestamp, tag, and expiry fields. It omits `id`, and import generates a new one.)
   ```javascript
   const posts = [
       {
           "embedCode": "...",
           "postLink": "https://www.threads.com/@user/post/...",
           "author": "@user",
           "content": "...",
           "timestamp": "2026-05-29T02:00:00.000Z",
           "timestampTitle": "May 29, 2026, 10:00 AM",
           "savedAt": "2026-05-29T02:10:00.000Z",
           "tags": ["JavaScript"],
           "status": "active",
           "expiredAt": "",
           "expiredReason": "",
           "expiredCheckedAt": ""
       }
   ];
   ```
   Note: `<script>` tags are stripped from `embedCode` on export and re-appended on import.

### Import Pipeline
- Sources: a file picker (`.js` / `.json`) in both surfaces, plus a paste-text dialog in the popup.
- `.json` files are parsed directly with `JSON.parse` (bare array or `{ "savedArticles": [...] }` wrapper). `.js` files and pasted text go through a three-stage resilient parser: `JSON.parse` -> dynamic evaluation via `new Function` -> token-based regular expression extraction.
- Modes: Merge (deduplicates on `postLink` and appends new posts to the end of the list) or Overwrite (replaces the entire database, gated behind a second confirmation modal).

## Security & Content Security Policy (CSP)
- Permissions: `storage`, `tabs`, `scripting`
- Host Permissions: `https://www.threads.com/*`, `https://threads.com/*`, `https://www.threads.net/*`, `https://threads.net/*`
- CSP Headers: `script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; frame-src https://www.threads.com https://www.threads.net https://*.threads.com https://*.threads.net;` (No inline scripts, no remote CDN scripts)
- PostMessage Security: Strict origin allowlist (`threads.net`, `threads.com`, `instagram.com`) plus a bounded height range on incoming iframe resize messages.
- XSS Prevention: Safe text node rendering (`textContent` / `escapeHtml`) for user-controlled strings in dashboard preview metadata, and `sanitizeUrl` for every rendered link or iframe source.
- Storage Safety: `safeStorageGet` / `safeStorageSet` guard against `Extension context invalidated` exceptions after an extension reload.

## Development & Local Testing
- Pure front-end extension with zero build steps and zero local server requirements.
- Clone repository and navigate to `chrome://extensions/` in Chromium-based browsers.
- Enable **Developer Mode** in the top right.
- Click **Load unpacked** and select the project root directory.
- Conventions: no inline styles or inline event handlers (strict CSP), no native browser dialogs, new modals must implement focus trapping and focus restoration, and any stored-field change must be mirrored in README.md, this file, and the export/import modules.
- Community files (Traditional Chinese): [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md) (setup, manual test checklist, commit and PR flow), [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](./CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md), [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md) (vulnerabilities go through GitHub private vulnerability reporting, not public issues), [ACCESSIBILITY.md](./ACCESSIBILITY.md) (WCAG 2.2 AA target and known limitations). Issue forms and the PR template live in `.github/`.
